notes: Modified cash basis ESU; single General Fund, no business-type funds. Beginning/ending cash = fund balance beginning/end of year (p4; ending = cash 5,370,713 + county treasurer 295,919). Receipts: the fund statement (p3) prints only broad groups (Local, State, Federal, Nonrevenue); each was split into the lines printed on the budget-and-actual schedule (pp5-6), which add to each printed group. 'Other local' 159,792 assumed other local government per ESU account-code rule (review). Nameplate capacity tax and carline tax = other taxes. Disbursements use the fund statement's program lines (pp3-4; Psychological etc. combine the regular and below-age-five lines). Private/state categorical and federal programs put in category instruction (guess; review). Detail: revenue from the budget-and-actual schedule (pp5-6, actual and final budget; 'Other federal' actual blank recorded as 0); expenditures from the operational-expenses exhibit by program x object (pp8-12), which supersedes the function-only budget schedule lines (not double counted; budget_final for expenditures not available by object). 'Other expenses' lines classed miscellaneous expenditure (review). Capital outlay lines classed equipment purchases. Cash-basis statement; no proprietary funds. Read pages 1-12 of 12
